result.note: The visit is only planned, so I tested the durable fact of where the world's largest single-site refining complex is located.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's India itinerary included Jamnagar, home to the world's largest single-site refining complex. In which state is Jamnagar located?
questions.explain: Jamnagar is in Gujarat. It houses Reliance Industries' refinery, which processes 1.4 million barrels a day. The State Department said Rubio's visit would include discussions on enhanced energy cooperation.
questions.source: Jamnagar, in Gujarat, houses Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Industries’ refinery, the world’s largest single-site refining complex, which processes 1.4 million barrels a day.
